summary: Report aged stop deferrals for live seats whose owner run is terminal.

schema.detail: Uses existing diagnostic and operational failure fields; no database migration.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: A stop deferred for at least 15 minutes by unread mail or another run's work raises a fault when its owner run is terminal. The fault appears on the historical agent card and in fault routing, with the retention reason and explicit stop command. The existing retention and process stop behavior is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to use the change. Interruption duration has not been measured.

recovery.detail: Deferral age is fenced by declaration and incarnation and survives daemon restarts. Faults clear when retention ends or the runtime stops; replaced declarations and incarnations hide stale episodes. Rollback restores diagnostic-only visibility.
